title_en: Dream of the Red Chamber (19/20): The House Is Raided
note_en: 散得七零八落 "scattered in all directions" uses the four-character idiom (chengyu) 七零八落, literally "seven scattered, eight fallen," meaning everything is in pieces and all over the place. Numbers like 七 and 八 in idioms don't count anything; they just mean "lots, in a mess," as in 乱七八糟 "a total mess." Note also the complement 得 after the verb: 散得七零八落 tells you how the family scattered.
